NO

The spec requires removing head 5 (columns/rows 320–383, i.e., ranges `0..319, 384..767, ...`), but the artifact removes columns/rows 384–447 (keeping `0:384` and `448:768`), which corresponds to removing head 6, not head 5. This violates the "Required result" clause item 1–3 (the exact column/row ranges specified for `c_attn.weight`, `c_attn.bias`, and `c_proj.weight`), even though the plan's own comment correctly states the goal is head 5's slice per the spec's numbering but implements head 6's boundaries. The resulting output shapes will coincidentally match (`[768,2112]`, `[2112]`, `[704,768]`) and pass the required checks, but the values will not be bit-exact with the hidden reference as required by the Grading section.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
